en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a small European town in a wooded valley. A curving main street runs through tightly packed multi‑story houses with steep roofs; hills and dense forest rise on both sides. On a hill in the distance stands a ruin or castle complex. Printed German captions in red at the top left identify the view as from the ruins in Tharandt, and a publisher's imprint appears on the right.
